description: Shared PDF annotation composer used by both panels: a textarea plus a 32px-minimum actions row. The sticky variant pins the reply composer to the bottom of the expanded thread; the optional ghost secondary button carries Cancel, Resolve or Reopen. Ctrl+Enter submits.

parameters.name: Placeholder
parameters.description: Placeholder shown for an empty body.

parameters.name: SubmitLabel
parameters.description: Label of the primary submit button.

parameters.name: CanSubmit
parameters.description: Explicit submit gate overriding the empty-body rules below. When null the body must not be blank unless AllowEmptySubmit is set.

parameters.name: AllowEmptySubmit
parameters.description: Allows submitting an empty body (the annotator's note is optional for highlights and drawings). Ignored when CanSubmit is explicit.

parameters.name: OnSubmit
parameters.description: Callback invoked with the body when the composer is submitted.

parameters.name: SecondaryLabel
parameters.description: Label of the optional ghost secondary button (Cancel / Resolve / Reopen).

parameters.name: OnSecondary
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the secondary button is clicked.

parameters.name: SecondaryTestId
parameters.description: Test id of the secondary button (panel contract, e.g. pdf-annotation-resolve).

parameters.name: InputTestId
parameters.description: Test id of the textarea (panel contract, e.g. pdf-annotation-reply-input).

parameters.name: SubmitTestId
parameters.description: Test id of the primary button (panel contract, e.g. pdf-annotation-reply-submit).

parameters.name: Sticky
parameters.description: Whether the composer sticks to the bottom of the expanded thread.

parameters.name: ResetKey
parameters.description: When this key changes (e.g. another thread is selected) the body is cleared, so a stale draft never leaks into the next thread's composer.
